I am writing to formally raise a complaint regarding the ongoing difficulty I have experienced in trying to obtain a medical appointment.
For several months, since around the Christmas period, I have repeatedly attempted to book an appointment. Each time, I am told that the surgery is too busy and that no appointments are available. I am consistently advised to call at 8:00 a.m., which I have done on numerous occasions, yet I am still refused an appointment due to alleged overcrowding.
I would like to clearly state that I am pregnant and I frequently feel unwell. I urgently require medical care. The continuous refusal to provide me with an appointment not only affects my own health but may also put my unborn child at risk. I find this situation extremely concerning and unacceptable.
Access to medical care during pregnancy is a fundamental right. The lack of support and the repeated inability to secure an appointment has caused me significant stress and anxiety during an already vulnerable time.

I respectfully request that I be offered an urgent appointment or provided with a clear and concrete solution to this situation. I expect a prompt response and appropriate
